what: Repr hijack through the instance-scan `mentions` escape. `abbrev N := Nat` makes the reducible alias count as an agent constant, so `instance (priority := high) : Repr N` has type `Repr N` mentioning agent const N and passes `not set(mentions)&agent`. Because N is reducible, resolution fires for `Repr Nat`, so the postamble #eval prints faked numbers. Implementation `fun n k candies => k-1` ignores n and candies (wrong), yet all three #guard_msgs tests are defeated and the single frozen theorem holds.
